items.exampleEn: Sarcasm can be hard to understand in a second language.
items.exampleZh: 用第二語言時，諷刺的話可能很難聽懂。

items.exampleEn: Her story about meeting a famous singer on the bus sounded fanciful.
items.exampleZh: 她說在公車上遇到知名歌手，聽起來像是編出來的。
items.glossZh: 異想天開的；不切實際的

items.exampleEn: The speaker opened with a quick quip about the weather.
items.exampleZh: 講者一開場就拿天氣說了句俏皮話。

items.exampleEn: Her husband is an agreeable man who gets along with everyone.
items.exampleZh: 她先生個性隨和討喜，跟誰都處得來。
items.glossZh: 令人愉快的、隨和的；欣然同意的
distractorsZh: 令人厭煩的、難相處的；反對的
危險的、不安全的；猶豫的

items.exampleEn: My grandparents love to reminisce about their first home.
items.exampleZh: 我的爺爺奶奶很喜歡追憶他們的第一個家。

items.exampleEn: The puppy's exuberance made everyone laugh.
items.exampleZh: 小狗活蹦亂跳的樣子把大家都逗笑了。

items.exampleEn: The film takes a funny look at hypocritical attitudes in a small town.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影用幽默的角度，看一個小鎮裡種種虛偽的態度。

items.exampleEn: The company was found negligent for not repairing the broken stairs.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司因為沒有修理壞掉的樓梯，被認定有疏失。

items.sentenceEn: The idea of a city floating on the sea once seemed fanciful.
items.sentenceZh: 一座漂浮在海上的城市，這個想法曾經看似異想天開。

items.audioEn: The babysitter was negligent and left the front door open all afternoon.
items.audioZh: 那位保母很疏忽，整個下午都讓前門開著。
items.questionZh: 保母做了什麼疏忽的事？
options: She left the front door open

items.sentenceEn: She quipped that her cat was the real boss of the house.
items.sentenceZh: 她打趣地說，她的貓才是家裡真正的老大。

items.sentenceEn: They danced with great exuberance at their friend's wedding.
items.sentenceZh: 他們在朋友的婚禮上跳舞跳得熱情洋溢。

items.stemEn: It is ____ of him to criticize others for being late when he is never on time himself.
items.stemZh: 他自己從來不準時，卻批評別人遲到，真是虛偽。

items.stemEn: Her reply was full of ____, so I knew she was not really pleased.
items.stemZh: 她的回答充滿了挖苦，所以我知道她其實並不高興。

items.passageEn: Twenty years after high school, our class held a reunion at an agreeable little restaurant by the river. We spent hours reminiscing about our teachers. Mr. Chen, our old history teacher, came too, and his exuberance had not faded at all. Someone reminded him that he once called us the most negligent class in the school's history, because we never cleaned the classroom when it was our turn. He quipped that we had finally improved. Some old habits remained: Wendy still answered every question with gentle sarcasm. When Daniel, always a little eccentric, described his fanciful plan to sail around the world on a boat he built himself, everyone laughed, but nobody called it impossible. That would have been hypocritical, since most of us had once had the same dream.
items.passageZh: 高中畢業二十年後，我們班在河邊一家氣氛宜人的小餐廳辦同學會。我們花了好幾個小時追憶老師們。我們以前的歷史老師陳老師也來了，他的熱情一點都沒減。有人提起，他以前說我們是全校史上最不盡責的班，因為輪到我們打掃時從來不掃。他打趣說我們終於進步了。有些老習慣還在：Wendy 回答每個問題時，還是帶著溫和的挖苦。一向有點古怪的 Daniel 說起他異想天開的計畫——要搭自己做的船環遊世界，大家都笑了，但沒有人說那不可能。那樣說就太虛偽了，因為我們大多數人以前也有過同樣的夢想。

questions.questionZh: 陳老師以前怎麼說這個班？
options: 全校史上最不盡責的班

questions.questionZh: 為什麼沒有人說 Daniel 的計畫不可能？
options: 因為陳老師答應要陪他一起航行全世界
因為他已經把船造好，下個月就要出發
因為大家以前也有過同樣的夢想
因為他的家人都很支持他

items.promptZh: 那位保全人員因為值班時睡著，被認為失職。
referenceEn: The security guard was considered negligent because he fell asleep on duty.
Because he fell asleep at work, the guard was seen as negligent.
rubricZh: 「失職的」用 negligent，例如 was negligent、was considered negligent、was found negligent 等
「被認為」可寫，例如 was considered、was seen as、was found 等
「值班時睡著」可寫，例如 fell asleep on duty、fell asleep at work 等

items.promptZh: 經理欣然同意了我們延長午休的提議。
referenceEn: The manager was agreeable to our idea of a longer lunch break.
Our manager was agreeable to the suggestion of extending the lunch break.
rubricZh: 「欣然同意」用 be agreeable to＋名詞（例如 was agreeable to our idea 等）
「延長午休」可寫，例如 a longer lunch break、extending the lunch break 等
